---
title: "School schedules and mothers' employment"
date: "2023-01-01"
description: "Full-day school schedules in Chile increased mothers' labor force participation and employment outcomes."
categories: ["Education Policy", "Labor", "Applied Microeconometrics"]
---

## Research question
What happens to mothers' labor outcomes when schools move from half-day to full-day schedules?

## Published in
Review of Economics of the Household, 2023.

## Journal link
- [Journal link](https://doi.org/10.1007/s11150-022-09599-6)

## Main contribution
Using quasi-experimental variation from an education reform in Chile, we find positive effects on labor force participation, employment, and hours worked.

## Reproducibility
- Data source: restricted survey/panel data
- Code release: available on request
- Replication package: to be added

## Storytelling
The reform changes childcare constraints through school-time infrastructure, which translates into measurable labor market effects for mothers.
